title: UpdateManifest
description: A signed worker release manifest (protocols.md §7, ADR 13). The coordinator produces it; the worker verifies the signature against a pinned public key before touching a byte. The signature (ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, base64 DER) covers the newline-joined version, rid, sha256, channel, url, protocol_version — pinning a specific artifact by sha256.

rid.description: Release-artifact key, e.g. py3-none-any — the key the coordinator resolved for this node's worker flavour (see heartbeat-request.agent_flavour).

sha256.description: Artifact digest; the worker verifies the download against it.

protocol_version.description: Queue-contract protocol the release speaks (skew gating).

signature.description:
base64(DER ECDSA-P256/SHA-256) over version
rid
sha256
channel
url
protocol_version. url and protocol_version are covered so an on-path attacker can neither redirect the fetch host nor stall the fleet with an inflated protocol version.
